checks.s: The document identifies itself as SOW #001, Statement of Work No. 001, or an equivalent.
The SOW references MSA No. CNHS-MSA-2025-0042 and states it was executed on January 15, 2025.
The SOW states the Verdantis Deal ID as VRD-2025-00187.
The SOW states an Effective Date of May 1, 2025.
The SOW identifies the Provider as Verdantis Solutions, Inc., a Delaware corporation.
The SOW identifies the Client as Caldwell National Health System, Inc., a Maryland nonprofit corporation.
The SOW includes a precedence clause referencing MSA § 14.2 that says the MSA governs conflicts except where the SOW expressly states a more protective standard.
The Scope of Work describes Phase 1 of the CaldwellConnect Intake & Interoperability Platform (CCIP), covering design, development, integration testing, and go-live deployment.

The SOW names all four pilot hospitals with these locations: Caldwell Memorial Hospital — Baltimore, MD; Caldwell Chesapeake Medical Center — Annapolis, MD; Caldwell Northern Virginia Hospital — Arlington, VA; and Caldwell Capital Region Hospital — Washington, D.C.
The SOW indicates that the four pilot hospitals are part of a larger 14-hospital system.
The SOW specifies integration with Caldwell's existing Epic EHR (November 2024 release) via HL7 FHIR R4 APIs.
The SOW states a minimum sustained throughput of 2,500 patient-record transactions per hour per facility and an aggregate minimum of 10,000 transactions/hour across all four sites.
The SOW states the Total Fixed Fee for Phase 1 as $8,640,000.
The milestone payment table includes exactly six milestones with percentages of 15%, 15%, 20%, 20%, 15%, and 15%, summing to 100%.
M1 is listed with target date May 1, 2025 and description “SOW Execution & Kickoff” or a substantively equivalent description.
M2 is listed with target date July 15, 2025 and description “Requirements & Design Approval” or a substantively equivalent description.
M3 is listed with target date November 14, 2025 and description “Development Complete (Code Freeze)” or a substantively equivalent description.
M4 is listed with target date January 15, 2026 and description “Platform Staging & Integration Testing Start” or a substantively equivalent description.
M5 is listed with target date March 31, 2026 and description “UAT Complete” or a substantively equivalent description.
M6 is listed with target date May 15, 2026 and description “Go-Live & Final Acceptance” or a substantively equivalent description.
The SOW specifies a 10% retainage or holdback on each milestone payment.
The SOW states or implies total retainage of $864,000 (10% × $8,640,000).
The SOW states that retainage is released upon Final Acceptance.
The rate card lists Senior Architect at $385/hr.
The rate card lists Lead Engineer at $310/hr.
The rate card lists Engineer II at $245/hr.
The rate card lists QA Analyst at $195/hr.
The rate card lists Project Manager at $275/hr.
The SOW states that rates are fixed for 24 months from the SOW Effective Date.
The SOW states that after the 24-month rate-lock period, rates escalate by CPI-U capped at 3.5% per year.
The SOW states an expense cap of $432,000 or 5% of the Total Fixed Fee.
The SOW specifies that travel, lodging, and per diem are reimbursed at federal GSA rates.
The SOW includes an early-completion bonus of $216,000 or 2.5% of $8,640,000.
The SOW states that the early-completion bonus is payable if Final Acceptance occurs on or before March 15, 2026.
The SOW states delay liquidated damages of $14,400 per calendar day.
The SOW caps delay liquidated damages at $864,000 or 10% of the Total Fixed Fee.
The SOW references Nightfall Cloud Services hosting at $37,500/month or $450,000/year as a pass-through cost.
The SOW states hosting fees commence at Milestone 4 (Platform Staging, January 15, 2026).
The SOW expressly states or structures the Nightfall arrangement so that no privity or direct contractual relationship is created between Caldwell and Nightfall.
The SOW states that Verdantis retains full responsibility to Caldwell for hosting-tier SLAs and does not pass through Nightfall liability.
The SOW specifies a 10-business-day acceptance period after delivery of a milestone completion notice.
The SOW includes deemed acceptance when Caldwell does not deliver a written deficiency notice within the 10-business-day acceptance period.
The SOW defines Sev-1 (Critical), Sev-2 (Major), Sev-3 (Minor), and Sev-4 (Cosmetic).
The SOW states that Go-Live requires zero open Sev-1 defects.
The SOW states that Go-Live allows no more than five (5) open Sev-2 defects, each with an agreed remediation plan.
The SOW states that Sev-3 and Sev-4 defects may remain open at Go-Live.
The SOW specifies a UAT duration of 45 calendar days, from February 14, 2026 through March 31, 2026.
The SOW states a platform uptime benchmark of 99.5% measured over a 30-consecutive-calendar-day stability period post-go-live.
The SOW states an average API response time SLA of ≤ 400 ms at the 95th percentile (p95).
The SOW includes a 12-month warranty period commencing upon Final Acceptance (projected May 15, 2026 – May 15, 2027 if on-time).
The SOW states the warranty covers Sev-1 and Sev-2 defects attributable to Verdantis work product at no additional charge.
The SOW specifies Sev-1 warranty response within 1 hour and a resolution target of 4 hours.
The SOW specifies Sev-2 warranty response within 4 hours and a resolution target of 1 business day.
The SOW references the Verdantis BAA with Ref. CNHS-BAA-VRD-2025, dated January 15, 2025.
The SOW references the Nightfall BAA with Ref. CNHS-BAA-NCS-2025, dated February 3, 2025.
The SOW states that both Verdantis and Nightfall are Business Associates of Caldwell under HIPAA/HITECH.
The SOW references Verdantis's SOC 2 Type II audit dated September 30, 2024 with Report ID VRD-SOC2-2024-AR.
The SOW references Nightfall's FedRAMP Moderate authorization dated June 12, 2023 with Package ID FR-MOD-NCS-2023-0041.
The SOW requires all PHI to reside within the continental United States.
The SOW specifies encryption at rest using AES-256.
The SOW specifies encryption in transit using TLS 1.3.
The SOW requires an independent third-party penetration test before UAT commences.
The SOW states Caldwell retains the right to commission its own penetration test at Caldwell's expense.
The SOW requires Technology Errors & Omissions insurance at $10,000,000 per occurrence and $15,000,000 aggregate.
The SOW requires Cyber Liability / Privacy & Network Security insurance at $10,000,000 per occurrence.
The SOW requires Commercial General Liability insurance at $2,000,000 per occurrence and $5,000,000 aggregate.
The SOW requires Workers' Compensation at statutory limits.
The SOW states that its insurance requirements supplement MSA § 11.
The SOW states Verdantis retains ownership of all pre-existing IP and the CCIP platform code (Provider IP).
The SOW states Caldwell owns configuration data, custom workflows, and bespoke integration adapters developed exclusively for Caldwell (Client IP).
The SOW grants Caldwell a perpetual, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use Provider IP embedded in deliverables solely for Caldwell's internal operations.
The SOW requires Verdantis to deposit source code in escrow with Iron Vault Escrow Services, Inc. under a three-party escrow agreement.
The SOW requires source-code deposit within 30 days of M3, by December 14, 2025.
The SOW specifies escrow release triggers including Verdantis insolvency, material uncured breach with a 60-day cure period, and discontinuation of support.
Annex D lists Priya Chandrasekaran as Engagement Lead with a 40% minimum commitment through the SOW term.
Annex D lists Marcus Adeyemi as Solution Architect with 100% commitment through M3 and 50% for M4–M6.
Annex D lists Juniper Tran as Integration Lead with 100% commitment for M2–M5.
Annex D lists Dr. Nadia Okonkwo as HIPAA Compliance Lead with 25% commitment throughout.
Annex D lists Dr. Raymond Liu as Caldwell Project Sponsor for governance and escalation.
Annex D lists Brian Halloran as Caldwell Technical Lead for day-to-day technical decisions.
The SOW requires 30 days' prior written notice for key-person replacements.
The SOW requires Caldwell's consent for key-person replacements and states that consent shall not be unreasonably withheld.
The SOW requires replacement personnel to have substantially equivalent qualifications.
The SOW states either party may submit a written Change Order Request (COR).
The SOW requires Verdantis to provide a written impact assessment covering cost, schedule, and risk within 7 business days of a COR.
The SOW states no change is effective until both parties execute the Change Order.
The SOW requires additional approval from Caldwell's CFO Thomas Andreasen for Change Orders exceeding $500,000 individually or $1,500,000 in aggregate.
The SOW provides Caldwell the right to terminate for convenience on 60 days' written notice.
The SOW states that upon convenience termination Caldwell pays for accepted milestones plus documented wind-down costs capped at 15% of the remaining unpaid balance.
The SOW specifies a 30-day cure period for cause termination and notes that this is shortened from the MSA § 12 default of 45 days.
The SOW provides transition assistance for up to 90 calendar days post-termination/expiration at rate-card rates.
The SOW expressly states that its termination provisions supplement MSA § 12.
The SOW expressly states that the shortened 30-day cure period constitutes a “more protective standard” under MSA § 14.2, thereby validly overriding the MSA's 45-day default.
The SOW lists Verdantis's notice address as 4200 Congress Avenue, Suite 1400, Austin, TX 78701, Attn: Priya Chandrasekaran.
The SOW includes a copy-to for Verdantis notices to Douglas R. Oates, Kessler, Oates & Fenn LLP, 200 South Wacker Drive, Suite 3100, Chicago, IL 60606.
The SOW lists Caldwell's notice address as 7500 Woodlawn Drive, Suite 800, Baltimore, MD 21208, Attn: Sarah Kwan-Morales.
The SOW includes a copy-to for Caldwell notices to Tanya Brevard, Brevard Hargrove LLP, 1700 K Street NW, Suite 900, Washington, D.C. 20006.
The SOW states it is governed by the laws of the State of Maryland.
The SOW includes a signature block for Priya Chandrasekaran with title VP, Enterprise Delivery (or VP Enterprise Delivery) on behalf of Verdantis Solutions, Inc.
The SOW includes a signature block for an authorized signatory on behalf of Caldwell National Health System, Inc. with spaces for printed name, title, and date.
The SOW includes Annex A titled “Scope & Deliverables Description” or a substantively equivalent title, populated with deal-specific scope information.
The SOW includes Annex B titled “Milestone Payment Schedule” or a substantively equivalent title, populated with the six milestones, dates, percentages, and amounts.
The SOW includes Annex C titled “Rate Card” or a substantively equivalent title, populated with the five roles and rates.
The SOW includes Annex D titled “Key Personnel” or a substantively equivalent title, populated with the six named individuals and their roles/commitments.
The SOW includes Annex E titled “Acceptance Criteria & Testing Protocol” or a substantively equivalent title, populated with acceptance periods, severity classifications, and go-live gate criteria.

The SOW includes Annex F titled “Security & Regulatory Requirements” or a substantively equivalent title, populated with HIPAA/HITECH, BAA references, encryption standards, and other security requirements.
The SOW states late-payment interest at 1.0% per month or 12.68% APR, consistent with MSA § 7.4.
The SOW references Nightfall's 99.9% infrastructure uptime SLA.
The SOW references Nightfall disaster-recovery specifications of RPO of 1 hour and RTO of 4 hours.

The SOW clearly distinguishes Nightfall's 99.9% infrastructure uptime SLA from the platform-level uptime SLA that Verdantis owes Caldwell (99.5% over 30 consecutive calendar days post-go-live), and makes Verdantis responsible for the platform-level SLA.
The SOW contains no unfilled bracketed placeholders (e.g., [INSERT], [TBD], [●]), unresolved drafting notes, or template comment bubbles.
The SOW states hosting fees begin at Milestone 4 (Platform Staging, January 15, 2026), not at an earlier milestone.
The SOW clearly presents hosting fees as a separate line item from and in addition to the $8,640,000 Total Fixed Fee.

The SOW references the $43,200,000 full-program TCV across five phases only in appropriate background context, without creating a binding commitment to future phases or implying that the SOW covers more than Phase 1's $8,640,000.
The SOW clearly states it covers Phase 1 only at $8,640,000 and creates no binding obligation for future phases.
